Terrible Experience – Avoid This Place

We booked a room online through Booking.com. When we arrived, the property refused to accept the booked price and demanded double the amount we had confirmed online.

After paying the inflated price, the room they gave us was in terrible condition.

The room was very dirty. The bedsheets and pillows were old, stained, and unpleasant to use. Overall, this was one of the worst hotel experiences we’ve had — extremely unprofessional and not worth half of the money.
